    RETURN CODE=return f(x,y); ORDER=1
      CALL NAME=f CODE=f(x,y) TYPE_FULL_NAME=I METHOD_FULL_NAME=f ORDER=1 DISPATCH_TYPE=STATIC_DISPATCH

        IDENTIFIER NAME=y CODE=y TYPE_FULL_NAME=I ORDER=2 ARGUMENT_INDEX=2
  METHOD_RETURN CODE=RET TYPE_FULL_NAME=I ORDER=4
